identification: Two large Moorcroft Burslem lustre vases (yellow/orange monochrome), impressed MOORCROFT BURSLEM ENGLAND and number, c.1920s. Marks seen in photo 2; one footed, one plain baluster, so not a pair. Lustre monochromes were Moorcroft's cheap line, far below the tube-lined patterns.

viewing_check: Measure heights (large ones, 30cm+, are better) and check the base flaking, rim and body for hairlines or cracks with a light (stress cracks common). Photograph the impressed marks and any painted initials or signature; confirm the number and that it reads Moorcroft Burslem (pre-1930s) not Made in England.
